```{python}
#| include: false

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from pathlib import Path

# ==========================================
# 1. LOAD DATASET
# ==========================================

cwd = Path.cwd()

candidates = [
    cwd / "dataset" / "credit_card_fraud_detection_2026.csv",
    cwd.parent / "dataset" / "credit_card_fraud_detection_2026.csv",
    cwd.parent.parent / "dataset" / "credit_card_fraud_detection_2026.csv"
]

DATASET_PATH = next(
    (p for p in candidates if p.exists()),
    None
)

if DATASET_PATH is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Dataset tidak ditemukan.")

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)

# ==========================================
# 2. DETECT COLUMNS
# ==========================================


def find_col(candidates):
    lookup = {str(c).lower(): c for c in df.columns}

    for name in candidates:
        if name.lower() in lookup:
            return lookup[name.lower()]

    return None


date_col = find_col([
    "transaction_datetime"
])

fraud_col = find_col([
    "is_fraud"
])

country_col = find_col([

    "merchant_country"])

if not all([date_col, fraud_col, country_col]):
    raise ValueError(
        f"Kolom tidak lengkap. Kolom tersedia: {df.columns.tolist()}"
    )

# ==========================================
# 3. PREPROCESSING
# ==========================================

df[date_col] = pd.to_datetime(
    df[date_col],
    errors="coerce"
)

if (
    pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[fraud_col])
    or pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(df[fraud_col])
):
    df["fraud"] = (
        pd.to_numeric(df[fraud_col], errors="coerce")
        .fillna(0)
        .eq(1)
    )
else:
    df["fraud"] = (
        df[fraud_col]
        .astype(str)
        .str.lower()
        .str.strip()
        .isin(["1"])
    )

df["country"] = (
    df[country_col]
    .fillna("Unknown")
    .astype(str)
)

df["month"] = df[date_col].dt.to_period("M")

# ==========================================
# 4. KPI
# ==========================================

total_transactions = len(df)

total_fraud = int(df["fraud"].sum())

total_non_fraud = total_transactions - total_fraud

# ==========================================
# 5. MONTHLY TREND
# ==========================================

monthly = (
    df.dropna(subset=[date_col])
    .groupby(["month", "fraud"])
    .size()
    .unstack(fill_value=0)
    .reindex(columns=[False, True], fill_value=0)
    .rename(columns={
        False: "Non-Fraud",
        True: "Fraud"
    })
    .sort_index()
)

monthly.index = monthly.index.astype(str)

# ==========================================
# 6. TOP COUNTRIES
# ==========================================

top_countries = (
    df.groupby("country")
    .size()
    .nlargest(10)
    .sort_values()
    .reset_index(name="transactions")
)

# ==========================================
# 7. FRAUD HEATMAP
# ==========================================

top_fraud_countries = (
    df[df["fraud"]]
    .groupby("country")
    .size()
    .nlargest(10)
    .index
)

heatmap_data = (
    df[df["fraud"] & df[date_col].notna()]
    .groupby(["country", "month"])
    .size()
    .unstack(fill_value=0)
    .reindex(index=top_fraud_countries, fill_value=0)
    .sort_index(axis=1)
)

heatmap_data.columns = heatmap_data.columns.astype(str)

# ==========================================
# 8. VALIDATION
# ==========================================

assert total_transactions == total_fraud + total_non_fraud
assert len(top_countries) <= 10
assert len(heatmap_data) <= 10

print("========== VALIDATION SUCCESS ==========")
print(f"Dataset           : {DATASET_PATH}")
print(f"Total Transactions: {total_transactions:,}")
print(f"Total Fraud       : {total_fraud:,}")
print(f"Total Non-Fraud   : {total_non_fraud:,}")
print(f"Top Countries     : {len(top_countries)}")
print(f"Heatmap Shape     : {heatmap_data.shape}")
print("========================================")
```

## Row {height="35%"}

### Monthly Fraud vs Non-Fraud

```{python}
#| title: "Monthly Transaction Trend"

fig_trend = go.Figure()

fig_trend.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=monthly.index,
        y=monthly["Non-Fraud"],
        name="Non-Fraud",
        mode="lines+markers",
        line=dict(color="#3984C6", width=2),
        yaxis="y"
    )
)

fig_trend.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=monthly.index,
        y=monthly["Fraud"],
        name="Fraud",
        mode="lines+markers",
        line=dict(color="#D9534F", width=2),
        yaxis="y2"
    )
)
```

```{python}
)


fig_country
```

### Column {width="60%"}

#### Monthly Fraud Heatmap

```{python}
fig_heatmap = go.Figure(
    data=go.Heatmap(
        z=heatmap_data.values,
        x=heatmap_data.columns.tolist(),
        y=heatmap_data.index.tolist(),
        colorscale="Reds",
        colorbar=dict(title="Fraud Count"),
        hovertemplate=(
            "Country: %{y}<br>"
            "Month: %{x}<br>"
            "Fraud: %{z}<extra></extra>"
        )
    )
)


fig_heatmap
```
